summary.en: End-to-end creative for the China debut of Jordan's global 1-on-1 finals: the tournament's visual world, teaser film, social rollout and on-site graphics.
summary.zh: 为 Jordan 全球 1 对 1 单挑赛总决赛首次落地中国打造全案创意：赛事视觉世界、预告影片、社交传播与现场空间物料。

summary.en: Design, motion and photography for The One: WeChat posters, per-heat films, athlete posters and POV stills.
summary.zh: The One 赛事的设计、动态与摄影：微信海报、分站赛影片、球员海报与第一视角剧照。

summary.en: A new visual identity and content suite for the 2026 Next Stop Dong Dan tournament and products, shot with an international production crew.
summary.zh: 为 2026 年 Jordan「下站东单」赛事与产品打造全新视觉识别与内容物料，携手国际制作团队完成拍摄。

summary.en: A Double 11 campaign that folds product and brand expression into one story around the Air Jordan 1, with hip-hop artist Asen and other brand catalysts.
summary.zh: 以 Air Jordan 1 为核心，把产品战役与品牌表达整合成一个故事的双 11 战役，携手说唱歌手艾志恒等品牌伙伴。

name: The Fearless Ones — Double 11 Social Content

summary.en: Social content for The Fearless Ones: WeChat stories, lookbook imagery and e-commerce assets for the Double 11 Air Jordan 1 push.
summary.zh: 「看我这 1 代」双 11 社交内容：微信图文、造型大片与电商物料，为 Air Jordan 1 造势。

name: Our Turn — Brand Voice & Family China Tour

summary.en: Bringing Jordan's 2024 global brand voice campaign to Greater China: narrative, key visuals, the Family China Tour film, social content, OOH and a mini program.
summary.zh: 将 Jordan 2024 年全球品牌战役「Our Turn」落地大中华区：叙事与文案、主视觉、中国行影片、社交内容、户外媒体与小程序。

summary.en: Our Turn on the ground: social content, OOH, and the Jordan Family China Tour mini program with itinerary, quizzes and rewards.
summary.zh: 「Our Turn」落地执行：社交内容、户外媒体，以及集行程、答题与奖励于一体的 Jordan Family 中国行小程序。

summary.en: 360° campaign support for the 2026 China debut of Wilson's WSP collection: hero key visuals, bespoke PR seeding kits, external design, co-branding partnerships and KOL seeding.
summary.zh: 为 Wilson WSP 系列 2026 年中国首发提供 360° 战役支持：主视觉设计、定制 PR 种草礼盒、对外设计、联名合作与 KOL 种草。

summary.en: Campaign concept, narrative and the brand voice film for Jordan's Year of the Dragon CNY collection.
summary.zh: 为 Jordan 龙年新春系列提供战役概念与叙事，并制作品牌影片。

summary.en: Full campaign assets for Converse's Chinese New Year campaigns: concepts, messaging, main films, key visuals, lookbooks and styling motion content.
summary.zh: Converse 新春战役全套物料：概念、文案、主片、主视觉、型录与造型动态内容。

summary.en: Two brand films for Next Stop Dong Dan, Jordan's elite basketball community initiative, carrying the brand's point of view and the Dong Dan spirit.
summary.zh: 为 Jordan 精英篮球社区项目「下站东单」创作两支品牌影片，传递品牌态度与东单精神。

summary.en: Introducing the new PMP certification exam to China across the full candidate journey: official site, WeChat mini program, airport OOH and email.
summary.zh: 协助 PMI 将全新 PMP 认证考试引入中国，覆盖考生全旅程：官网、微信小程序、机场户外与邮件营销。

summary.en: A brand voice film for BLACKHEAD's 15th anniversary, following four individuals across generations to show jewelry as everyday armor for identity.
summary.zh: 为 BLACKHEAD 十五周年创作品牌影片，以四位不同世代的人物，讲述饰品如何成为个人身份的日常铠甲。

summary.en: Year-round campaign films and key visuals for Coach Fragrance with artist Liu Yu, from Qixi romance to holiday warmth.
summary.zh: 携手艺人刘宇，为 Coach 香水执导并制作全年战役影片与主视觉，从七夕的浪漫到节日的温暖。

summary.en: An International Women's Day campaign for OGR with artist Li Jiage, echoing the metamorphosis idea behind the brand's butterfly-cocoon sneaker.
summary.zh: 携手艺人李嘉格，为 OGR 打造 2026 妇女节战役，呼应品牌蝶茧鞋款背后的「蜕变」概念。

summary.en: Two content waves with Thai talent for BLOSSOMIN's body wash launch, with scripts tailored to each artist's persona.
summary.zh: 为 BLOSSOMIN 沐浴露上市执导两波泰国艺人内容，按每位艺人的人设定制叙事脚本。

summary.en: A narrative mini-drama commercial launching SOFEI's new blush with Thai duo LING & ORM, built to travel on social.
summary.zh: 为 SOFEI 新款腮红上市执导剧情短片广告，由泰国组合 LING & ORM 出演，为社交传播而生。

summary.en: Four Hong Kong musicians, followed through neon streets, night markets and milk tea shops, for the Air Max 95.
summary.zh: 为 Air Max 95 跟拍四位香港音乐人，穿行于霓虹街头、夜市与茶餐厅。

summary.en: Concept and production of Burton's 2026 Chinese New Year campaign shoot for the Year of the Horse.
summary.zh: Burton 2026 马年新春战役的创意与拍摄制作。

summary.en: Season-long creative content across all of Decathlon's winter sports categories, supporting the overall winter campaign launch.
summary.zh: 整合迪卡侬全部冬季运动品类，产出贯穿整季的创意内容，支持冬季战役上线。

summary.en: A shoot pairing an elevator set with changing weather to show what Moose Knuckles' 3-in-1 jacket does in everyday life.
summary.zh: 以电梯场景搭配变化的天气，呈现 Moose Knuckles 三合一外套在日常中的功能。

summary.en: Campaign visuals and motion built on a gravity-defying "aerial float" idea for Moose Knuckles' Lightweight Jacket series.
summary.zh: 以「空中漂浮」为概念，为 Moose Knuckles 轻量外套系列执导并制作战役视觉与动态内容。

summary.en: Concept-to-production creative assets for Salomon's key trail running shoe, Genesis, with the Greater China team.
summary.zh: 携手 Salomon 大中华区团队，为主力越野跑鞋 Genesis 提供从概念到制作的创意物料。

summary.en: A Year of the Snake campaign pairing Chinese paper-cutting craft with Salomon's snowboard design, in visuals and film.
summary.zh: 将中国剪纸工艺与 Salomon 蛇年单板设计结合，以视觉与影片讲述带有中国元素的滑雪故事。

summary.en: Creative concept, visual direction, key visuals, stills and a brand video for Peak Performance's FW25 Color Shell launch.
summary.zh: 为 Peak Performance FW25 Color Shell 系列上市提供创意概念与视觉方向，并制作主视觉、平面与品牌影片。

summary.en: Social films with RED creators and national team sprinter Ge Manqi, showing the softness of Nike Yoga's Zenvy collection through everyday scenes.
summary.zh: 携手小红书达人与国家队短跑运动员葛曼棋创作系列社交影片，以日常场景演绎 Nike Yoga Zenvy 系列的柔软。

summary.en: "Jordan Meets Love": stories and fashion-forward content around key footwear and apparel for Valentine's Day and Qixi.
summary.zh: 以「Jordan Meets Love」为概念，为情人节与七夕创作故事内容与时尚向的鞋服大片。

summary.en: A kids campaign built on the belief that Jordan kids can achieve anything they set their minds to, once they have the drip.
summary.zh: Jordan 儿童系列战役：Jordan 小孩相信只要用心就无所不能，但首先得有型。

summary.en: Style-led content for Jordan's Remix series, where classic Jordan designs are mixed into new shoes.
summary.zh: 为 Jordan Remix 系列创作造型向内容，呼应将经典 Jordan 设计混搭成新鞋款的产品理念。

summary.en: A lookbook for the Air Peg 2K5 built on the "morning fit check", with everyday ways to style retro runners.
summary.zh: 以「出门前的穿搭检查」为灵感，为 Air Peg 2K5 打造复古跑鞋日常穿搭型录。

summary.en: Sneaker art direction and still-life imagery for Nike, Jordan and Converse footwear marketing.
summary.zh: 为 Nike、Jordan 与 Converse 的鞋款营销提供球鞋艺术创意与静物影像。

summary.en: Styling assets across four seasons for UGG, built on self-discovery and comfort as part of a long-term partnership.
summary.zh: 在与 UGG 的长期合作中，围绕「自我探索」与「舒适」产出四季造型物料。

summary.en: A new e-commerce photography and visual style for UGG's Tmall flagship and WeChat mini program, cleaner and more premium.
summary.zh: 为 UGG 天猫旗舰店与微信小程序焕新电商摄影与视觉风格，更简约、更有质感。

summary.en: Content that blends urban aesthetics with pan-Asian style to strengthen Samsonite's presence across Asia.
summary.zh: 以都市美学融合泛亚洲风格的内容，提升 Samsonite 在亚洲市场的品牌认知。

summary.en: The SS21 Gradient Color Collection launch for Apede Mod: a Douyin filter and all-channel assets supporting the store opening and offline activation.
summary.zh: Apede Mod SS21 渐变色系列上市：开发抖音滤镜与全渠道物料，支持店铺开业与线下活动。

summary.en: Product shoots, campaign films and key visuals for Le Creuset's Pets Collection, in the brand's saturated colour.
summary.zh: 为 Le Creuset 宠物系列上市执导产品拍摄、战役影片与主视觉，延续品牌标志性的饱和色彩。

summary.en: A retro 8-bit basketball game that turns an elite athlete's journey, from campus to the Jordan Family, into a playable adventure.
summary.zh: 一款复古 8-bit 像素篮球游戏，把精英球员从校园到加入 Jordan Family 的历程变成可玩的冒险。

summary.en: A three-phase gamified campaign on Nike Tmall Kids for parents and kids to play together: 283.7K visitors and ¥13.9M GMV.
summary.zh: Nike 天猫儿童店三阶段互动游戏战役，让家长与孩子一起玩：28.37 万访客，GMV 1390 万元。

summary.en: A redesign of Jordan's Tmall flagship, a store with 15 million followers: five modules rebuilt and two new ones added.
summary.zh: 为拥有 1500 万粉丝的 Jordan 天猫旗舰店改版：重新设计 5 个模块，新增 2 个。

name: World of Flight — Grand Opening O2O AR Experience

summary.en: An AR digital hub for the opening of Jordan's Beijing World of Flight store; 10% of users went on to visit, and it won Store Opening of the Year at the Glossy Fashion and Luxury Awards 2024.
summary.zh: 为 Jordan 北京 World of Flight 开业打造 AR 数字互动平台；10% 的用户到店，并获 2024 Glossy Fashion and Luxury Awards 年度开店奖。

summary.en: "Member Land", a clay-crafted digital world for Nike Member Days across the Nike App and WeChat mini program, lifting app traffic by over 52%.
summary.zh: 为 Nike 会员日打造黏土风数字世界「Member Land」，贯通 Nike App 与微信小程序，App 流量提升超 52%。

summary.en: A digital hub with AR shoe try-on for Nike's Air for Athletes collection, launched for the Paris 2024 Olympics and Paralympics.
summary.zh: 为巴黎 2024 奥运会与残奥会期间发布的 Nike Air for Athletes 系列开发带 AR 试鞋的数字互动工具。

summary.en: An immersive H5 that takes users inside the Monitor II ANC headphones, reaching 60M social exposures.
summary.zh: 带用户走进 Monitor II ANC 耳机内部的沉浸式 H5，社交曝光达 6000 万。

summary.en: An interactive vinyl-turntable H5 for the Jordan Music Festival store, with a 90-second average stay.
summary.zh: 为 Jordan 音乐节店铺打造黑胶唱机互动 H5，平均停留 90 秒。

summary.en: A lightweight quiz game for the Jordan Family China Tour, with 7.38M unique visitors and 90% engagement in its first week.
summary.zh: Jordan Family 中国行轻量答题小程序：738 万独立访客，首周互动率 90%。

summary.en: A WeChat mini program hub that turns Nike's seasonal campaigns into collectible cards, linking followers to member benefits and commerce.
summary.zh: 把 Nike 季度战役变成可收集卡片的微信小程序互动中心，将粉丝导向会员权益与电商。

summary.en: "Jordan Family Day", an always-on community programme on the 23rd of every month, each drop a product-led interactive card.
summary.zh: 「Jordan 飞翔家族日」：每月 23 日的常态化社区项目，每期以一张产品向互动卡片上线。

summary.en: An engagement platform for Nike during the CHBL season where school fans earn points for their teams: 95% active users and 913K+ page views.
summary.zh: Nike 在 CHBL 赛季期间的互动平台，校园球迷为主队赢取积分：活跃用户 95%，总浏览量超 91.3 万。

summary.en: Ongoing work on the Nike Training Club mini program: year-round communication, online course shoots, in-app assets and trainer management.
summary.zh: Nike Training Club 小程序长期运营：全年传播规划、线上课程拍摄、站内物料与教练关系管理。

summary.en: Contributing to the signature basketball court design and creating release design for Jordan's SU25 Luka 4 campaign, online and offline.
summary.zh: 参与 Jordan SU25 Luka 4 战役的签名球场设计，并完成线上线下的发布设计。

summary.en: Store design elements and LED packages for Jordan World of Flight stores and retail sites across China, adapted to each campaign.
summary.zh: 为中国各地的 Jordan World of Flight 门店与零售点位，按不同战役设计店铺元素与 LED 物料。

summary.en: Concept work for O2O and digital engagement, plus release design, for Nike's HO25 Swoosh Puffer campaign.
summary.zh: 参与 Nike HO25 Swoosh Puffer 战役的 O2O 与数字互动概念，并完成线上线下的发布设计。

summary.en: Full-platform brand design for La Mer: official website, digital service content, in-store light boxes and more.
summary.zh: 为 La Mer 提供全平台、全触点品牌设计：官网、数字服务内容、门店灯箱等。

summary.en: Brand design release for Estée Lauder across multiple platforms, starting Fall 2025.
summary.zh: 自 2025 年秋季起，为雅诗兰黛提供多平台的品牌设计发布服务。

summary.en: Key visuals for YSL's Double 11 Tmall campaign, built from 3D models in the brand's fashion show tone.
summary.zh: 为 YSL 天猫双 11 设计主视觉，以 3D 建模呈现品牌时装秀的视觉调性。

summary.en: FRESH OFF, a running magazine for Nike made of stories from runners met on tracks, city streets and trails.
summary.zh: 为 Nike 打造跑步杂志 FRESH OFF《跑了再说》，收录在跑道、街头与山野遇见的跑者故事。

summary.en: 3D characters, scenes and product models, with illustration, made for brand campaigns.
summary.zh: 为品牌战役创作的 3D 角色、场景、产品模型与插画。

summary.en: Chinese campaign logos and lockups for Nike, Jordan and Converse.
summary.zh: 为 Nike、Jordan 与 Converse 设计的中文战役标识与组合字标。

summary.en: The visual rollout for Chuck 70 X with ambassador KARINA, adapted across digital flagships, e-commerce pages and OOH in subways and malls nationwide.
summary.zh: 携手品牌代言人 KARINA，完成 Chuck 70 X 全触点视觉落地：线上旗舰店、电商落地页，以及全国地铁与商场户外大屏。

summary.en: Social strategy and execution for Harbin Beer × NBA's new ambassador duo, Dylan Wang and Tyrese Haliburton, in a phased rollout with KOLs.
summary.zh: 为哈尔滨啤酒 × NBA 全新代言人组合王鹤棣与哈利伯顿的社交官宣提供策略与执行，分阶段释出并联动 KOL。

summary.en: A Converse reality show bringing 12 up-and-coming artists to a music camp mentored by Khalil Fong, with label 明堂唱片 and Bilibili creators.
summary.zh: 携手明堂唱片与 B 站创作者打造 Converse 音乐真人秀「爱小声」，12 组新声代音乐人参加由方大同担任导师的音乐营。

summary.en: Two years establishing Converse Basketball in Greater China: strategy, key visuals and films, events, live streams and talent management.
summary.zh: 历时两年在大中华区建立 Converse 篮球：策略规划、主视觉与影片、活动制作、直播与球员管理。

summary.en: Nike trainers take NTC courses to the streets and challenge passers-by, turned into short-form video content.
summary.zh: 携手 Nike 教练把 NTC 课程带上街头，向路人发起挑战，并产出短视频内容。

summary.en: Key visuals, story films and social posts for Snowboard Day, Salomon's offline event connecting top athletes with the snowboarding community.
summary.zh: 为 Salomon「神级玩家」Snowboard Day 创作主视觉、主题影片与社交内容，这是品牌连接顶尖滑手与单板社群的线下活动。

summary.en: WeChat editorials for a range of brands, weaving together stories, product inspiration and interaction.
summary.zh: 为多个品牌定制微信图文，融合故事、产品灵感与互动。

summary.en: WeChat editorial content for Nike and Jordan across brand campaigns, product launches and community stories.
summary.zh: 为 Nike 与 Jordan 制作微信图文内容，涵盖品牌战役、产品上市与社区故事。
